mapper.select: SELECT c.*, m.nickname AS writer FROM comment c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.parent_id ASC, c.depth DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (board_id, member_id, content, created_at, updated_at, ref, depth, level, parent_id) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, now(), now(), #{ref}, #{depth}, #{level}, #{parentId})
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET ref = #{commentId} WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND ref = 0

mapper.delete: DELETE c FROM comment c LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT parent_id FROM comment WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL) sub ON c.comment_id = sub.parent_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId} AND sub.parent_id IS NULL;
